newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Fresenius opens regional HQ in Sydney.
newsitem.headline: Fresenius opens regional HQ in Sydney.

text.p: German health care group Fresenius Medical Care is to establish its Southeast Asian regional headquarters in Sydney, Australian Industry, Science and Tourism Minister John Moore said on Monday.
Moore said that after Fresenius' initial investment in regional headquarters, it planned to expand the existing fluid factory in Sydney to further enhance export revenue.
Fresenius' regional headquarters would centralise management, purchasing and sales for Taiwan, Singapore and Australia subsidiaries, as well as exports to Southeast Asia.
